official.deadline_note: The published last date for applicants to submit applications on the A2A Portal was 15 April 2026; the revised ICCR timeline widened the student application window to 27 February - 22 April 2026. University scrutiny ran to 31 May 2026, Mission selection to 15 June 2026, a second round of selection ran 15-30 June 2026, and the indicative joining window was June to August 2026.
official.status_note: The A2A Portal states that scholarship registration for the academic year 2026-27 is closed; the 2026-27 cycle has passed through university scrutiny, Mission selection and the joining window.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The Facilities row for the scheme reads: 'Stipend, HRA, Contingent Allowances, Thesis/Dissertation Allowance, Airfare, Tuition fee/OCF paid to Universities (Norms attached)'.
benefits: Monthly stipend of INR 18,000 at undergraduate level, INR 20,000 at postgraduate level and INR 22,000 at Ph.D. level
Monthly House Rent Allowance of INR 6,500 in Grade I cities and INR 5,500 in other cities for UG and PG, and INR 12,500 for Ph.D. scholars
Annual Contingent Allowance of INR 5,000 for undergraduates and INR 7,000 for postgraduates and above (admitted in AY 2023-24 onwards)
Annual Contingent Allowance of INR 10,000 for Ph.D. scholars
One-time thesis and dissertation allowance of INR 7,000 for BBA/BCA/BF/MA/M.Tech and other courses requiring submission of a project, and INR 10,000 for Ph.D. scholars
Tuition fee and other compulsory fees paid directly to the Universities/Institutes
Return economy class airfare to the airport nearest the place of study, plus 3-tier AC train fare where required, for students of Mexico and Turkmenistan only
eligibility: National of one of the 23 countries listed under the Dr. S. Radhakrishnan Cultural Exchange Scholarship Scheme (116 slots in total)
Undergraduate, postgraduate or Ph.D. level courses, in STEM or Non-STEM streams
Minimum age of 18 years and maximum age of 35 years for UG, PG, Certificate and Diploma courses, and 40 years maximum for Ph.D., as at 1 July 2026
Passport valid for a minimum of two years as on 1 July 2026
Courses in Medical Science, Para-medical fields, Law and Integrated courses are excluded
Applicants for Ph.D. courses must submit a synopsis of the research topic, which must not involve data collection outside India as far as possible
Applicants with PIO/OCI status must have completed schooling up to Standard XII abroad and not studied in India in the preceding five academic years (three years for PG) to be eligible
requirements: Apply online only, through the A2A Scholarship Portal; applications sent by any other mode to the Indian Mission, ICCR or the university are not accepted
Make only one application on the A2A Portal during the academic year - multiple registrations lead to rejection of all applications
Select up to five Universities/Institutes and courses in order of priority; a change of course or university after the award is not permissible
Write the mandatory 500-word essay in English on one of the topics listed on the A2A Portal
Be proficient in English, to the standard set by the Indian Mission
After selection, accept or reject the offer within 7 days on the portal and upload the Medical Fitness Certificate within the prescribed time limit
documents: Valid passport with a minimum of two years' validity as on 1 July 2026
Passport-size photograph with a white background and both ears visible, to the A2A Portal specifications
Mark sheets and the Birth Certificate, School Leaving Certificate and Nationality Certificate, in English and in original for verification at admission
Transcript or syllabus of the last qualifying examination
A synopsis of the research topic, for Ph.D. applicants
Certificates or scores from global English proficiency tests such as TOEFL or IELTS, optionally uploaded as proof of English
Medical Fitness Certificate with test reports and vaccinations, issued by a reputed hospital or laboratory, on the prescribed format
Registration on the Study in India (SII) Portal to create the unique ID needed for the visa application
selection_criteria: Scrutiny by the chosen Universities/Institutions for grant of admission in the applied course and stream
Selection by the Indian Mission against the number of slots allocated under the scheme for that country, on merit
The Indian Mission reserves the right to accept or reject any application at any stage without assigning reasons
Grant of admission does not guarantee the award of a scholarship
coverage: Tuition fee and other compulsory fees, paid by ICCR to the Universities/Institutes
Monthly stipend, House Rent Allowance, annual contingent allowance and thesis/dissertation allowance
Return economy class airfare and, where required, 3-tier AC train fare, for students of Mexico and Turkmenistan only
application_method: Register on the A2A Portal through the Student's Registration option and note the User ID and password issued by email
Complete the application form, uploading documents to the portal's specifications, saving after each page, then press Submit to receive a registration number
The chosen Universities/Institutions scrutinise the application independently and upload provisional admission confirmation on the A2A Portal
The Indian Mission evaluates the candidate for the award of scholarship and issues an offer letter, which must be accepted or rejected within 7 days on the portal
Complete pre-departure formalities, register on the SII Portal, obtain the Student Visa (S-1) or Research Visa (S-5) for Ph.D., and join the course within the time-frame in the offer
official.application_route: Register and apply on the ICCR A2A Scholarship Portal only, choosing up to five universities/institutes in priority order, with the application submitted through the Indian Embassy in the applicant's country.
official.citizenship_residency: Only nationals of the 23 countries listed under the scheme are eligible; 21 of those countries are listed 'without airfare' and 2, Mexico and Turkmenistan, with airfare.
official.international_eligibility: The scheme is exclusively for foreign nationals of the 23 listed countries with which India holds cultural exchange arrangements; it is not open to Indian citizens.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: STEM and Non-STEM streams are both offered at UG, PG and Ph.D. level. Medical Science, Para-medical courses such as Nursing, Physiotherapy, anaesthesia and lab technician courses, Law and Integrated courses such as BALLB and integrated B.Sc./M.Sc. are all prohibited. Scholarships are provided only for structured courses of one year or more, and not for short-term certificate, diploma or research courses. A GMAT score is mandatory for MBA admission at some universities, and performing-arts applicants must upload a performance video link.
official.research_requirement: Applicants for Ph.D. courses are required to submit a synopsis of their research topic with the application, and must ensure the topic does not involve data collection in the home country or any other country outside India as far as possible.
official.duration: One academic year or more, matching the structured course applied for. ICCR norms restrict the maximum period of scholarship to five years for a Ph.D. course, plus a maximum of six months to defend the thesis or for the viva voce.
official.description: The Dr. S. Radhakrishnan Cultural Exchange Scholarship Scheme, formerly the Cultural Exchange Programme and Education Exchange Programme, is offered under the ICCR Scholarship Programme to nationals of 23 countries for undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral study at Indian universities and institutes in STEM and Non-STEM streams. It is administered through the A2A (Admission to Alumni) Portal and funded by ICCR.
official.program_type: Government of India scholarship under the ICCR Scholarship Programme for cultural exchange countries
official.english_requirement: Universities and institutes conduct their classes for foreign students in English, and applicants must be proficient enough to speak fluently and comprehend lessons in English, to the standard determined by the Indian Mission. A mandatory 500-word essay in English on a topic listed on the A2A Portal must be submitted, and certificates or scores from tests such as TOEFL or IELTS may optionally be uploaded.

verification.notes: The stored a2ascholarships.iccr.gov.in scheme URL returns a server error, so research used ICCR's own domains: the ICCR Scholarship Schemes page for 2026-27 (23 countries, 116 slots, UG/PG/PhD levels, prohibited streams, and the airfare exception limited to Mexico and Turkmenistan), the official Policy_Guidelines.pdf for the level-specific allowance table and all application rules, the official Timeline-AY-2026-27.pdf for cycle dates, and the ICCR Scholarship FAQs. No aggregator figures were used.

applicant_utility.summary: This is the widest-reaching ICCR scheme - 116 slots across 23 countries at undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral level, in both STEM and Non-STEM subjects - but it is also the one most people misread on airfare. Only Mexico and Turkmenistan get a ticket, so if your country is one of the other 21 you must fund your own flight. The money itself is level-banded: INR 18,000 a month at UG, 20,000 at PG and 22,000 at Ph.D., with house rent allowance of 6,500 or 5,500 (12,500 at doctoral level), annual contingency and a one-off thesis grant, and tuition paid straight to your university. Because slots are tiny per country, the practical discipline is to file one perfect application in the opening days rather than several.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Applicants from the 23 listed cultural-exchange countries who want a funded degree at an Indian university and can cover their own airfare if they are not from Mexico or Turkmenistan.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your country appears on the 23-country list and note how many slots it holds before investing time in the application
Budget for a return economy airfare yourself unless you are a national of Mexico or Turkmenistan
Rank up to five universities and courses in priority order, remembering that neither can be changed after the award
Draft the mandatory 500-word English essay on a topic listed on the A2A Portal, and upload TOEFL or IELTS certificates if you have them
For a Ph.D. application, prepare a research synopsis that does not depend on data collection outside India
Check your passport has at least two years' validity from 1 July 2026, and register on the SII Portal immediately if an offer arrives
common_rejection_risks: Submitting a second registration on the A2A Portal in the same academic year, which voids every application
Applying for a Medical, Para-medical, Law or Integrated course, all of which are explicitly excluded
Age breach on 1 July 2026 - 35 maximum for UG, PG, certificate and diploma, 40 for Ph.D., with no exceptions at those levels
A mismatch between portal entries and documentary evidence, which cancels the application outright
Assuming admission by a university secures the scholarship; the Mission selects only within its slot allocation
Missing the 7-day acceptance window or the medical fitness upload deadline after an offer is issued
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Return airfare for nationals of the 21 countries without an airfare provision, plus hostel or private accommodation charges, mess charges, security deposit and caution money, certificate fees, immigration registration fees and penalties, and any AIU equivalence certificate fee. ICCR advises carrying around USD 1,500 because it takes two to three months for allowances to start flowing.
document_audit: Photograph must be white background with both ears visible, to the portal's specification
Mark sheets, birth certificate, school leaving certificate and nationality certificate must be in English and produced in original at admission
The Medical Fitness Certificate must follow the prescribed format from a reputed hospital or lab, with test reports and vaccinations
PIO/OCI applicants must prove schooling up to Standard XII abroad and no study in India for the preceding five academic years (three for PG)
alerts: The 2026-27 round is closed and the A2A Portal confirms registration is shut; watch the portal and your Indian Mission for the next cycle rather than trusting aggregator sites
This is not a migration route: you must leave India after receiving your provisional marksheets and before your Residential Permit expires, and you may not work in India while studying
Stipend and HRA depend on academic progress - a failed year stops allowances and forces self-financed repetition, and semester progress reports are mandatory
Long stays outside India cut the stipend: more than one month away means the whole ex-India period is deducted, with HRA paid for at most two months
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on the A2A Portal, submit one application with up to five university choices and the mandatory essay, let the institutes scrutinise and post provisional admission, then await the Indian Mission's offer - accept within 7 days with a medical fitness certificate, complete SII and visa formalities, and join within the offer's time-frame.
